Intermediate.learningGoal: Refactor code so it can be unit tested: seams for time, randomness and I/O.
gotchas: Static calls (DateTime.Now, File.ReadAllText) baked into logic
Tests that depend on execution order
Hand-written fakes that re-implement the logic under test
goodSolutionShows: Small hand-written fakes (no mocking library needed)
shapeHints: a reminder service that decides who gets a notification today
a report exporter writing to disk

Advanced.learningGoal: Design for testability at module level: pure core, thin shell, fakes over mocks.
gotchas: Over-mocking leads to tests that assert implementation details
Async code tested with real delays
goodSolutionShows: Fakes with observable state instead of interaction assertions
shapeHints: a sync engine deciding which items to upload
a rate limiter with an injected clock
